title.narrative: 2024 GRANT TO MALAWI IRISH CONSORTIUM ON GBV OUTCOME 2

description.narrative: The Malawi Irish Consortium on Gender Based Violence (MICGBV) was established with the aim of Irish NGOs to coordinate and support on Gender Based Violence (GBV) in Malawi. By fostering better coordinationa nd communication, the project expects to contribute to the empowerment of women and the reduction of GBV in Malawi. The MICGBV promotes evidence-based programming on gender equality and Gender Based Violence and supports the relevant work of the Government of Malawi through the Ministry of Gender, Community Development and Social Welfare and other key stakeholders. The MICGBV has created platforms for shared learning and best practices and has promoted the collaboration and coordination of GBV stakeholders at national level through the National Gender Technical Working Group and the Sub Gender Based Violence Technical Working Groups.
